in_marathi.name: Bhawna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born from the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhawna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhawna is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhavana', which means 'to create', 'to form in the mind' or 'to imagine'. In Hindu mythology, Bhawna is a manifestation of the goddess Durga, representing the power of creation and nurturing. The name is believed to be auspicious and bestows creativity, imagination, and a nurturing nature upon the bearer.
